title: Profile
subtitle: Your details, preferences and password.
password_help: Changing it signs you out on other devices and turns off “Remember me” there.

fields.current_password_for_email: Current password (only needed to change your email)

help.email: Used to log in and to recover your password. A new address takes effect once you open the confirmation link we send to it.
help.student_id_once: Enter your student ID once. Contact the administration to change it later.
help.student_id_locked: Contact the administration to change your student ID.

errors.password_required_for_email: Enter your correct current password to change your email.
errors.too_many_password_checks: Too many wrong password attempts. Try again in :minutes minutes.
errors.too_many_email_changes: Too many email change requests. Try again in an hour.
errors.verification_not_sent: We couldn't send the confirmation email. Check the address and try again.
errors.email_taken: This email is now used by another account.

flash.password_changed: Password changed. Your other devices have been signed out.
flash.email_verification_sent: Your details were saved. To change your email, open the confirmation link we sent to the new address.
flash.email_changed: Your email was changed. Your other devices have been signed out.

email_change.pending: A confirmation link was sent to :email. Your login email stays the same until you open it (valid until :time).
email_change.confirm_text: Use this address to log in and to recover your password from now on?
email_change.confirm_effect: After you confirm, your other devices will be signed out and your old address will be told about the change.
email_change.invalid: This confirmation link is invalid, has expired or was already used. Request the change again from your profile.
